timeline.summary: Abda and Rigi meet Brin, Lukka and Vivien Reid north of Drannith; Abda greets Lukka with hostility.
timeline.quote: greeted him with hostility and warned of the dangers posed by urban factions

citation.text: "Abda and Rigi", section "Gathering of bonders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrow and Zeph arrive; Vivien says another planeswalker disturbed the Ozolith; Abda agrees to join out of loyalty to Brin.
timeline.quote: because of her loyalty to Brin and concern for the balance of the wilds

citation.text: "Abda and Rigi", section "Gathering of bonders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Abda is fatally struck by a projectile from the Vermilion while assisting Brin.
timeline.quote: Abda was fatally struck by a projectile fired from the skyship Vermilion

citation.text: "Abda and Rigi", section "Battle at the Ozolith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrow and Zeph join a gathering of bonders and allies in the wilds, greeted by Abda, Vivien Reid and Lukka.
timeline.quote: Zeph was immediately recognized as a formidable monster, and his presence drew attention for both his size and power.

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Gathering of bonders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Citadel war room Barrow, Vivien, Brin and Major Humron join Jirina to plan against Lukka's attack.
timeline.quote: In the Citadel's war room, Barrow, Vivien, Brin, and Major Humron joined her around a map of Drannith to prepare for Lukka's imminent attack.

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Monsters breach the inner city; Barrow and Zeph defeat several intruders before being overwhelmed.
timeline.quote: The pair intercepted and defeated several intruders but were soon overwhelmed by the scale of the incursion.

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The bonders and Vivien arrive at the Ozolith and plan for Lukka to reach the central crystal while the others hold off the nightmares.
timeline.quote: Vivien proposed a plan for him to reach the central crystal while the others held off the defenders

citation.text: "Battle at the Ozolith", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Johannes shoots Abda dead with the Vermilion's ballistae while Jirina observes.
timeline.quote: managed to land a fatal shot on Abda

citation.text: "Battle at the Ozolith", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lukka tries to seize Zeph and Rol; Vivien hurls him away with her Arkbow and the bonders flee.
timeline.quote: attacked Lukka with her Arkbow

citation.text: "Battle at the Ozolith", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brin and Roland meet Lukka and Vivien at a crystal formation on the Egali plains and agree to help reach the Ozolith.
timeline.quote: When Vivien and Lukka proposed joining forces to reach the Ozolith, Brin agreed to help

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Gathering of bonders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brin gathers bonded pairs, including Abda and Rigi and Barrow and Zeph, to coordinate a response to the disturbance in monsters.
timeline.quote: Brin's primary concern remained the safety of monsters

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Gathering of bonders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nightmare creatures surge from the crystal field and the Battle at the Ozolith begins.
timeline.quote: The Battle at the Ozolith started when the nightmare creatures surged from the crystal field.

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Battle at the Ozolith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Abda saves Brin but is killed by a bolt from the skyship Vermilion; the nightmares then overwhelm the hunters.
timeline.quote: A bolt from the skyship Vermilion struck Abda, killing her instantly.

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Battle at the Ozolith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lukka emerges altered, claiming the Ozolith has granted him control over the monsters to serve Drannith with a monstrous army.
timeline.quote: Brin listened as he explained that the Ozolith had granted him control over the monsters.

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Battle at the Ozolith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lukka tries to command Roland through the Ozolith; Vivien attacks him, letting Brin and the bonders flee.
timeline.quote: Vivien intervened by attacking Lukka, allowing Brin to flee.

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Battle at the Ozolith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brin and Roland enter Drannith with Jirina's group after Colonel Bryd is relieved of command.
timeline.quote: Once Bryd was relieved of command, Brin and Roland were accepted into the city

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The defenders plan Drannith's defense in the Citadel war room, and Brin reports that other bonders are on their way.
timeline.quote: She announced that Vheen and other bonders had heard Barrow's magical broadcast and were on their way.

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Siege of Drannith begins at sunrise as Lukka's army appears.
timeline.quote: as the Siege of Drannith started.

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Monsters breach the inner city and Brin relays Barrow's warnings to Jirina.
timeline.quote: some flyers and burrowers had bypassed the walls and were attacking civilians

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vivien's summoned monstrosaur turns the battle and the bonders encircle Lukka, ending the assault.
timeline.quote: the bonders encircled Lukka and brought the assault to a close.

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brin and Roland settle in the First Ring, symbolizing the alliance of humans and monsters.
timeline.quote: Brin and Roland were among the bonders permitted to settle in the First Ring of Drannith after the city's defense.

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "After the siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lukka gathers monsters with the Ozolith, kills Kudro with a trap, and besieges Drannith.
timeline.quote: personally killed Kudro by stabbing him in the heart

citation.text: "Drannith", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jirina returns to Drannith, deposes Colonel Bryd and takes command with Vivien and the bonders.
timeline.quote: assuming de facto command after successfully deposing Colonel Bryd

citation.text: "Siege of Drannith", section "Prelude". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jirina holds a war council and the First Ring is evacuated; Barrow calls other bonders to help.
timeline.quote: the First Ring was evacuated to consolidate defenses within the main wall

citation.text: "Siege of Drannith", section "Defense Preparations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The bonders charge through the gates, rescue Jirina and turn the tide; Vivien summons a monstrosaur to distract Lukka.
timeline.quote: rescuing Jirina and turning the tide of the battle

citation.text: "Siege of Drannith", section "The Siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The leaderless monsters scatter; afterwards Jirina becomes colonel and bonded humans and monsters may live in the First Ring.
timeline.quote: Jirina officially took the rank of colonel.

citation.text: "Siege of Drannith", section "Ignition and Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: She showed a protective attitude toward Brin
